apps.subtitle: Live sport, TV, movies and replays
apps.localizedDescription: Live sport from every source in one place, free-to-air and sports channels, Twitch, full-game replays, and movies and TV shows (with a TorBox account).

versions.localizedDescription: TV channels like HBO USA no longer keep jumping back to live. WWE PPV page only shows when a premium event is on.
Games on free-to-air show as live as soon as the TV coverage starts, so they're on Home before kick-off. Listings in other languages are hidden.
